Home.title: Current Top Firepower
Home.seo_title: Welcome to KCL — The Ultimate K-pop Company Voting Platform
Home.seo_intro: K-pop Company League (KCL) is the world's first fan-powered ranking platform dedicated to K-pop entertainment companies. Millions of fans from over 190 countries cast their votes daily to support their favorite companies and the artists they love. Whether you're passionate about HYBE, SM Entertainment, JYP Entertainment, YG Entertainment, or any of the dozens of other agencies shaping the K-pop industry, KCL gives you the power to make your voice heard.
Home.seo_how_desc: KCL operates on a unique league system inspired by European football. Companies compete in two divisions: the Premier League (1st Division) featuring top-performing companies, and the Challengers League (2nd Division) where rising companies battle for promotion. At the end of each monthly season, the bottom-ranked Premier League companies are relegated to Challengers, while the top Challengers earn their spot in the Premier League. This creates thrilling competition and gives every company a chance to reach the top.
Home.seo_vote_desc: Every fan receives daily votes that refresh at midnight (KST). No registration or login is required — simply visit KCL and cast your votes for the company you want to support. Your vote counts equally toward the real-time rankings, and you can track your impact as the numbers update instantly.
Home.seo_season_desc: KCL runs on a monthly season cycle. Each month brings a fresh start with reset rankings, giving every company an equal opportunity to compete. At the end of the season, the top-ranked company in the Premier League is crowned the monthly champion and inducted into the Hall of Fame.
Home.seo_global_title: A Global Platform for K-pop Fans
Home.seo_global_desc: Available in 12 languages including Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Indonesian, Turkish, Thai, and Vietnamese, KCL brings together K-pop fans from every corner of the world. Join the global community and make your voice heard.

HallOfFame.title: Hall of Fame
HallOfFame.subtitle: Legends of KCL
HallOfFame.seo_title: KCL Hall of Fame — Celebrating K-pop Company Champions
HallOfFame.seo_subtitle: The Hall of Fame honors the K-pop entertainment companies that earned the title of monthly champion through the passionate support of their fans.
HallOfFame.seo_how_desc: At the end of each monthly season, the company holding the #1 position in the Premier League is crowned that month's champion. Champions are permanently recorded in the Hall of Fame, preserving their achievement for all time. The Grand Champion title is reserved for the company with the most monthly victories across all seasons.
HallOfFame.seo_history_desc: Browse through the complete history of KCL champions, from the very first season to the present day. See which companies have dominated, which have made surprise appearances at the top, and how the competitive landscape has evolved over time. Each champion's record includes their total vote count, winning margin, and the season during which they earned their title.
HallOfFame.seo_legacy_desc: The Hall of Fame is more than just a record of winners — it's a testament to the power of K-pop fandoms worldwide. Every vote cast throughout a season contributes to the story told here. Will your favorite company be the next to join the Hall of Fame? Vote now and help write K-pop history.
HallOfFame.seo_system_desc: KCL's championship system operates on a monthly cycle. Each season begins on the first day of the month, and every company starts with zero votes. Throughout the month, fans from around the world cast their votes to push their favorite companies up the rankings. On the final day, the company at the top of the Premier League is permanently enshrined in the Hall of Fame. Grand Champions are determined by total monthly victories across all seasons — a true measure of sustained fandom dedication.

Analytics.title: Analytics
Analytics.subtitle: Vote Data Analysis
Analytics.seo_title: KCL Analytics — Vote Trends & Market Share Analysis
Analytics.seo_subtitle: Track Real-Time Voting Statistics Across K-pop Companies
Analytics.seo_intro: The KCL Analytics page provides in-depth insights into voting patterns and trends across all K-pop entertainment companies. Explore real-time data visualizations, market share breakdowns, and historical voting patterns to understand which companies are gaining momentum and which are facing challenges in the rankings.
Analytics.seo_trends_desc: Track hourly, daily, and monthly voting trends for every company in the league. Our interactive charts show you exactly when voting surges happen, helping you understand fan engagement patterns across different time zones and during special events such as comebacks and music award seasons.
Analytics.seo_market_desc: See how the total vote share is distributed among K-pop companies. The market share chart provides a clear visual representation of each company's popularity relative to the entire industry, updated in real-time as votes come in from fans around the world.
Analytics.seo_insights_desc: KCL Analytics transforms raw voting data into meaningful insights. Discover trending companies, identify voting patterns, and track the rise and fall of companies across seasons. Whether you're a casual fan or a K-pop industry analyst, our analytics tools give you the comprehensive data you need.
Analytics.seo_discover_desc: Explore top-voted companies by hour, analyze seasonal performance trends, compare company growth rates, and identify the most competitive battles in both the Premier League and Challengers divisions. Every data point is sourced from actual fan votes, making KCL Analytics a unique window into the global K-pop fandom.
Analytics.seo_realtime_desc: All analytics data updates automatically as new votes are cast. There is no need to refresh the page — watch the numbers change in real-time as fans around the world make their voices heard. The analytics dashboard is your window into the pulse of the global K-pop community, reflecting the latest shifts in fan engagement every hour.
Analytics.seo_compare_desc: Use KCL Analytics to compare your favorite company's performance against rivals. Track voting momentum during special events like comeback seasons, music award shows, and viral social media moments. See how fandom activity spikes and discover which companies benefit most from global K-pop trends.

About.title: About KCL
About.subtitle: What is K-pop Company League?
About.intro: KCL (K-pop Company League) is a global fan engagement platform where K-pop fans worldwide vote for their favorite entertainment companies to create real-time rankings.
About.how_it_works_1: Use your daily votes to support your favorite K-pop company.
About.how_it_works_2: Voting results are reflected in real-time rankings.
About.how_it_works_3: Operated on a monthly season system, with a new champion crowned each month.
About.how_it_works_4: A promotion/relegation system between leagues creates dynamic competition.
About.feature_1_desc: See rankings that update instantly with every vote.
About.feature_2_desc: Enjoy exciting competition with the Premier League and Challengers promotion/relegation system.
About.feature_3_desc: Browse historical season champions and records.
About.feature_4_desc: Get the latest K-pop industry trends and analysis reports.
About.feature_5_desc: Available in 12 languages including Korean, English, and Japanese for fans worldwide.
About.team_desc: KCL is operated by a small team of developers and designers who love K-pop. We strive to create a fair and transparent platform for fans to enjoy.
About.contact_desc: If you have any feedback, suggestions, or inquiries about KCL, please don't hesitate to reach out.
About.disclaimer: KCL is an unofficial fan-made platform and is not affiliated with any entertainment company.

FAQ.meta_description: Find answers to frequently asked questions about KCL. Learn about voting, league system, rankings, privacy, and more.
FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about KCL
FAQ.a1: KCL (K-pop Company League) is a global fan engagement platform where K-pop fans worldwide vote for their favorite entertainment companies to create real-time rankings. It is an unofficial fan-made service not affiliated with any entertainment company.
FAQ.a2: Simply click the 'Vote' button next to your favorite company on the main page. Votes are refreshed daily at midnight, and anyone can participate without registration.
FAQ.a3: Votes are automatically refreshed at midnight (KST). The number of daily votes is limited to ensure fair competition.
FAQ.q4: How does the league system work?
FAQ.a4: KCL consists of a Premier League (1st Division) and Challengers (2nd Division). At the end of each monthly season, bottom-ranked Premier League teams are relegated while top Challengers are promoted. This creates dynamic competition.
FAQ.a5: Rankings are based on the total votes each company receives during the current season (month). They update in real-time, and all votes carry equal weight.
FAQ.a6: KCL collects minimal information. We don't store actual IP addresses — only anonymized hashes. No registration is required, so we don't collect emails or passwords. See our Privacy Policy for details.
FAQ.a7: No. KCL is an unofficial fan-made service created by K-pop enthusiasts. It has no official affiliation or sponsorship with any entertainment company.
FAQ.q8: How can I report a bug or make a suggestion?
FAQ.a8: Please email us at contact@kcl.fan. Your feedback helps us improve KCL for everyone.
FAQ.a9: KCL currently supports 12 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Indonesian, Turkish, Thai, and Vietnamese.

Notice.title: Notices
Notice.subtitle: Stay updated with the latest news from KCL
Notice.seo_intro: Stay informed with the latest announcements, updates, and events from KCL. Our notices section keeps you up to date on platform changes, new features, upcoming events, and important policy updates. Whether it's a new season launch, a special voting event, or a system maintenance notice, you'll find all the important information here.
Notice.seo_categories_desc: Browse notices by category to find what matters to you. Official notices cover platform policies and important announcements. Update notices inform you about new features and improvements to KCL. Event notices highlight special activities, competitions, and fan engagement opportunities that you won't want to miss.
Notice.seo_stay_desc: KCL is constantly evolving to provide the best experience for K-pop fans worldwide. Check back regularly for the latest updates, or follow our announcements to never miss an important notice. Your feedback and participation help shape the future of KCL.
Notice.seo_why_desc: Staying informed about KCL updates ensures you never miss important changes that could affect your voting strategy. Season transitions, rule changes, special events, and new feature launches are all announced here first. By following our notices, you gain an edge in understanding when new seasons begin, how the promotion and relegation system evolves, and what exciting opportunities lie ahead for K-pop fans worldwide.
